title: Fix task addition and implement backend persistence for todos

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the task addition functionality in the TodoInput component so users can successfully add new tasks to the todo list
acceptanceCriteria: Users can type text into the input field and submit it
New tasks appear in the todo list immediately after submission
The input field clears after successful task addition
No console errors occur during task addition

file_operations.description: Debug and fix the task addition logic by examining the form submission handler, input state management, and integration with the addTask mutation from useQueries. Ensure the mutation is called correctly with the task text, error handling is in place, and the input field is cleared on success. Verify that the mutation invalidates the task list query cache to trigger an immediate UI update.

Review and fix the addTask mutation hook to ensure it correctly calls the backend actor's addTask method, handles errors appropriately, and invalidates the getAllTasks query cache on success. Verify that the mutation is properly configured with React Query's useMutation and returns the correct mutation function to the TodoInput component.

requirements.summary: Verify that the frontend correctly loads persisted tasks on initial page load by calling getAllTasks and rendering them in the TodoList component
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks appear immediately when the page loads
Previously checked tasks display with checked state
Previously unchecked tasks display with unchecked state

file_operations.description: Ensure the TodoList component correctly uses the getAllTasks query hook from useQueries to fetch and display persisted tasks on mount. Verify that the query is enabled by default, handles loading and error states appropriately, and maps the returned Task array to render each task with its correct checked state. Confirm that task order from the backend is preserved in the rendered list.

Review the getAllTasks query hook to ensure it correctly calls the backend actor's getAllTasks method and returns the task array. Verify that the query is configured with appropriate caching and refetch behavior, and that it's immediately enabled on component mount to load persisted data without delay.

Verify that the App component structure ensures the TodoList component is mounted and receives the necessary context (QueryClientProvider and actor) to fetch persisted tasks on initial page load. Confirm that no conditional rendering prevents the initial data fetch from occurring.
